## Purpose
The right-hand panel of the Processes page for a process or subprocess: its active document, every version with its status, and what was built with it.

## Responsibilities
- `ProcessPanel`:
- - `processesApi.document`;
- - `activate` ("Version N is now active.");
- - `deleteDocument` ("Deleted."), which asks once more when builds used it;
- - `downloadDocument`;
- - `DocumentSummary` and `UsageList`.
